question:
What will come in place of '?' in the following equation if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

= 109 + 605 ÷ 55 × 7 - 93

= 93

question:
Which two mathematical operators should be interchanged to balance the following equation?

19 - 39 × 3 + 25 ÷ 5 = 131
options:
+ and ÷  

÷ and ×

- and ÷

+ and ×
solution:
e correct answer is option 2 i.e. ÷ and ×.

Given Equation : 19 - 39 × 3 + 25 ÷ 5 = 131

After interchanging ÷ and × the equation is satisfied 

⇒ 19 - (39 ÷ 3) + 25 × 5 = 131

⇒ 19 - 13 + (25 × 5) = 131

⇒ (19 + 125) - 13 = 131

⇒ 144 - 13 = 131

⇒ 131 = 131

19 - 39 × 3 + 25 ÷ 5 = 131
options_hi:
+ और ÷  

÷ और ×

- और ÷

+ और ×
solution_hi:
ही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात् ÷ और × है।

दिया गया समीकरण : 19 - 39 × 3 + 25 ÷ 5 = 131

÷ और × को आपस में बदलने पर समीकरण संतुष्ट हो जाता है

⇒ 19 - (39 ÷ 3) + 25 × 5 = 131

⇒ 19 - 13 + (25 × 5) = 131

⇒ (19 + 125) - 13 = 131

⇒ 144 - 13 = 131

⇒ 131 = 131

question:

solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. ÷ and ×.

Given equation: 14 - 96 × 24 + 16 ÷ 4 = 74

Option 1: ÷ and ×

After interchanging the expression becomes:

14 - 96 ÷ 24 + 16 × 4 = 74

14 - 4 + 16 × 4 = 74

14 - 4 + 64 = 74

78 - 4 = 74

74 = 74

question:

question:
If P denotes '×', Q denotes '÷', R denotes '+', and S denotes '-', then what will come in place of '?' in the following equation?

\(\sqrt{256}\) P 3 S 66 Q 11 P 5 R 43 = ?
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 61.

Given conditions: P denotes '×', Q denotes '÷', R denotes '+', and S denotes '-'

Given equation:  \(\sqrt{256}\) P 3 S 66 Q 11 P 5 R 43 =?

After interchanging the expression becomes:

= \(\sqrt{256}\) × 3 - 66 ÷ 11 × 5 + 43

= \(\sqrt{256}\) × 3 - 6 × 5 + 43

= 16 × 3 - 30 + 43

= 48 - 30 + 43 = 61
